sloka: विश्वामित्र वचः श्रुत्वा कथान्ते रघुनंदन ।उवाच परम प्रीतो मुनिम् दीप्तम् इव अनलम् ॥१-३९-१॥
transliteration: viśvāmitra vacaḥ śrutvā kathānte raghunaṁdana ।uvāca parama prīto munim dīptam iva analam ॥1-39-1॥

translations.english: Immensely pleased with the words of Viswamitra, to the ascetic flaming bright like fire, Rama spoke towards the end of the narration:
